rulesets.description: Phase-2 production default (a_floor=0.55, hard drawdown)
rulesets.notes: Promoted from v1.2_candidate after policy matrix validation.

rulesets.description: v1.3.0 regime-aware drawdown (a_floor=0.60, near=120, mid=180, dd_rel=-0.20, require_both=True)
rulesets.notes: drawdown_rel_xbi_gate=-0.20, drawdown_gate_require_both=True. Supersedes 181346fe.

rulesets.description: No logic change. Version bump to pair with drift guardrail calibration (496b27b).
rulesets.notes: Identical parameters to v1.2.1_candidate. Drift guardrails tightened: rs_morningstar 70→85%, rs_unknown 10→8.5%, cat_eligible 80→95%, cs_ctgov 50→37%. Superseded by v1.3.0_candidate (enable_catalyst_priority).

rulesets.description: Schema expansion: catalyst_time_decay_mode (logistic decay behind config, default=hard)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.3.2 + catalyst_time_decay_mode=hard, catalyst_logistic_midpoint_days=150, catalyst_logistic_scale_days=30.0. No behavior change with default mode=hard. New output field: catalyst_decay_w.

rulesets.description: Candidate v1.3 (soft drawdown mode, a_floor=0.55)
rulesets.notes: Rejected: soft drawdown dilutes alpha and worsens P5 from -29% to -38%.

rulesets.description: Catalyst source/type ordering policy (enable_catalyst_priority=true)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.2.2 + enable_catalyst_priority=true. FDA events (priority=1) sort above CTGOV readouts (2) within same tier. Superseded by v1.3.2 (tiebreaker mode).

rulesets.description: Expanded priority map: SEC multi-form (10Q/10K/6K) + Federal Register (demoted to pri=3)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.3.0 + expanded catalyst_priority_map: SEC_10Q/10K/6K_FILING at pri=2, FEDERAL_REGISTER demoted from pri=1 to pri=3 (procedural notices, not drug decisions). Supports multi-form EDGAR collection.

rulesets.description: Defaults + rebalance_buffer_ranks field (0 = disabled by default)
rulesets.notes: Schema expansion: added rebalance_buffer_ranks=0. No behavioral change (disabled by default). Supersedes 260a85ab.

rulesets.description: Catalyst priority dampened: tiebreaker mode (comp_rank dominates, priority only breaks ties)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.3.1 + catalyst_priority_mode=tiebreaker, enable_catalyst_priority=false (deprecated). Acceptance target: <=5% rank changes vs mode=off.

rulesets.description: Missingness sort penalty only (promoted from candidate after 24-snapshot replay: 100% overlap)
rulesets.notes: Enables sort tie-break against incomplete data; no sizing cliffs. enable_missingness_sort_penalty=true, enable_missingness_size_penalty=false. Superseded by v1.4.0_alpha_cohort.

rulesets.description: Commercial tier promotion: tier_first mode (commercial A-tier competes with dev B/C in portfolio)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.3.3 + tiering_priority_mode=tier_first, tier_a_commercial_floor=0.85, tier_b_commercial_floor=0.60. Candidate — no promotion until replay + review.

rulesets.description: Clinical sort signal: tier-local z, stage-gated (mid=1.0, late=1.5), pos-only, clamped ±2.0, w=1.0
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.3.3 + enable_clinical_sort_signal=true, clinical_sort_weight=1.0, clinical_positive_only=true, clinical_stage_mults early=0/mid=1/late=1.5. Replay shows: 100% top-20/60 overlap, max churn 2, zero tier changes. Clinical affects within-tier ordering only.

rulesets.description: Alpha cohort composite engine + clinical sort signal (w=1.0) + missingness sort penalty
rulesets.notes: composite_engine=alpha_cohort, enable_clinical_sort_signal=true, enable_missingness_sort_penalty=true, catalyst_priority_mode=tiebreaker. Superseded by v1.5.0 (coinvest sort).

rulesets.description: Alpha modifier tiebreak mode: OOS alpha nudges within-tier ordering as last tiebreaker
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.5.1_coinvest_off + alpha_modifier_mode=tiebreak, alpha_modifier_weight=0.05, alpha_table_rebuild_policy=if_missing. RETIRED: tiebreak slot unreachable — unique upstream floats (alpha_cohort_pct) in sort key mean no two rows ever tie at positions 0-7. Zero rank shifts across 9 dates. Superseded by v1.6.1 (within_tier).

rulesets.description: Coinvest sort tie-breaker: z-scored tier1_count blended into sort anchor (w=0.05, pos-only)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.4.0 + enable_coinvest_sort_signal=true, coinvest_sort_weight=0.05, coinvest_positive_only=true, coinvest_score_mode=tier1_count. Calibrated from 0.05-0.50 sweep: w=0.05 gives 82% top-20 overlap (2 name changes), saturation at w=0.25 (5 names). Manifest-only active; actual pinned production was v1.5.1 (88d7ae9a).

rulesets.description: Coinvest sort OFF (w=0.0) + alpha cohort + clinical sort — actual pinned production ruleset
rulesets.notes: Was PHASE2_PINNED_RULESET_ID in run_screen.py but missing from manifest (oversight). Same as v1.5.0 but coinvest_sort_weight=0.0 (disabled). Superseded by v1.6.1 (alpha modifier within-tier, 0c1129f6).

rulesets.description: Alpha modifier within-tier: OOS alpha blended into effective_comp_rank (w=0.05)
rulesets.notes: Promoted from v1.6.1 candidate. Tiebreak mode (v1.6.0) was structurally unreachable; within_tier blends weight*alpha_raw into effective_comp_rank. Promotion check: 9 dates, 100% top-60 overlap, max shift=2, 0 tier-A regressions, 2.4% mean rows changed. Live pipeline run confirmed: alpha_modifier_ab.json sidecar + telemetry emitted.

rulesets.description: Calendar alpha v2 sort tilt: clinical_score_v2_z blended into sort anchor (w=0.3, pos-only)
rulesets.notes: Same params as v1.6.1 + enable_calendar_alpha_sort=true, calendar_alpha_sort_weight=0.5. 113 rank changes, max +35 (GH), max -15. Improvers are clinical-rich dev names; decliners are non-clinical. Tier A count stable at 28.

rulesets.description: Candidate: optionality sort anchor (sort_anchor=optionality_pct)
rulesets.notes: E_optionality ablation: sort_anchor=optionality_pct. Backtest 63/84/126d (2020-2026, 347 dates): spread +2.68/+3.23/+3.78pp vs baseline +0.64/+0.31/+1.53pp; turnover -15% (0.088 vs 0.103); IC -0.023/-0.031/-0.044 vs -0.028/-0.035/-0.049. Beats E+B combined at 126d.

rulesets.description: Simplification: alpha_modifier_mode=off (was within_tier w=0.05, proven zero-impact)
rulesets.notes: 5-way backtest 2020-2026 showed C_momentum_off==A_baseline exactly. Disabling within_tier at w=0.05 has no measurable effect on sort order. tiebreak mode is structurally dead. Ruleset-only change; no code behavior change.

rulesets.description: v1.9.0 coinvest sort signal at w=0.40 (optionality anchor). Empirically validated 2020-2025: +0.94pp/+0.55pp/+2.39pp spread at 63/84/126d vs fb0af0ac baseline, OOS t-stats 8-12, contra monotone. First weight to clear all governance bars.
rulesets.notes: REJECTED: look-ahead contaminated — all coinvest data from static Q3 2025 holdings_snapshots.json with no date field. PIT-correct re-evaluation showed signal harmful (IS 2025 paired t=-3.4 to -4.4 for level, t=-6.4 to -8.7 for delta). NOT PROMOTED.

rulesets.description: Clinical sort tilt OFF: disable enable_clinical_sort_signal + zero clinical_sort_weight
rulesets.notes: Derived from fb0af0ac (v1.8.1). Governance ablation showed clinical sort tilt net harmful at portfolio level (displacement effect): clinical OFF improved IC materially across 63/84/126d horizons. Clinical features remain computed/available; only sort contribution disabled.

rulesets.description: Portfolio mechanics: rebalance_buffer_ranks=30 (existing holdings stay unless rank > K+30)
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.8.2 (4f12a7f8). 4x4 turnover sweep (buffer x cap) OOS 2020-2024: buffer=30 dominates with +0.98pp 126d net, turnover 6.17%->2.03%. IS 2025 validation confirms improvement. No rerank needed — buffer is eval-time portfolio construction, not snapshot sort order.

rulesets.description: Institutional delta sort tilt: net_elite_holders_delta z-score blended into sort anchor (w=0.3, pos-only)
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.8.3 (82982998). IS 2026 (28 dates): 5d IC +0.0199 t=+6.96 win=93%, 20d IC +0.0366 t=+13.51 win=100%. Turnover -0.71pp vs baseline. Strongest sort signal since calendar alpha v2.

rulesets.description: Flatten tier sort within binary_91_180 bucket (less_binary): tier_ord=1 for all eligible names
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.9.0 (e966af9d). binary_91_180_flatten_tier_sort=true. IS 2025: +2.74pp 84d, +0.22pp 126d hedged. OOS flat (no tier diversity pre-2025). Only affects sort ordering inside binary_91_180 bucket; other buckets unchanged.

rulesets.description: binary_91_180 clinical quality sort tilt: clinical_quality_composite for CLINICAL family (w=0.5)
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.10.0 (bebe73f8). binary_91_180_sort_mode=clinical_quality, binary_91_180_clinical_quality_weight=0.5. Weekly A/B (eval_b91_clinical_quality_weekly_ab.py): cum hedged delta +2.58pp, mean weekly delta +0.03pp, turnover delta -0.02pp. CLINICAL-family names in less_binary bucket get clinical_quality_composite blended into sort anchor. Updated 2026-03-14: enabled far_window_days=540 for clinical coverage hydration.

rulesets.description: binary_91_180 within-bucket quality re-ranking: binary_quality_score as primary sort signal
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.10.0 (bebe73f8). binary_91_180_sort_mode=quality_primary. Full-portfolio OOS: +0.53pp 126d hedged, +0.26pp 84d hedged, turnover unchanged. 143/395 dates with global top-20 boundary crossings.

rulesets.description: Core-sleeve exposure neutralization: beta/drawdown/vol/mcap neutralized in core sleeve only
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.11.0 (7177a4ea). Identical parameters + exposure_neutralize_sleeve=core, exposure_neutralize_factors=[beta,drawdown,vol,mcap]. ARCHIVED: acceptance replay (30 dates, 2026-02-02..2026-03-10) shows real rank effects after wiring fix but ROLLBACK on cumulative hedged delta (-0.36pp vs +0.20pp threshold). Stability passed (top-20 median overlap 1.00, turnover delta 0). Both core sub-sleeves (binary_91_180, less_binary) contributed negative deltas. Earlier matrix PROMOTE was a false positive: IC was measured on alpha_cohort_pct which the live sort key (clinical_optionality_pct_dev) did not consume.

rulesets.description: Catalyst tilt ON: L3 sizing multipliers NEAR=1.10/MID=1.05/FAR=0.95/MISSING=0.90
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.11.0 (7177a4ea). Only change: enable_catalyst_tilt=true (mults already present). Analytical sweep (34 dates, 2025-06..2025-12): all 16 grid variants beat baseline. Best (default mults): +0.66pp 63d (80% win), +1.16pp 84d (96% win). Turnover impact <1%. Pure L3 sizing — no membership or sort order change. PROMOTION BATTERY 2026-03-13: 4/4 buckets PROMOTE (+5.8pp to +30.4pp), but weekly gate FAIL — bucket_binary_31_90 -1.81pp and global_cum_hedged -2.43pp trip tight per-bucket guardrails. Policy-level weekly metrics PASS (+4.14pp cum, +0.13pp mean). DECISION: shadow for 3-5 more weeks, then re-gate. Do not promote until weekly verdict clears.

rulesets.description: binary_91_180 clinical+options quality sort: CLINICAL uses clinical_quality_composite (w=0.5), REGULATORY uses options_quality_composite (w=0.5)
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.11.0 (7177a4ea). binary_91_180_sort_mode=clinical_plus_options, binary_91_180_clinical_quality_weight=0.5, binary_91_180_options_quality_weight=0.5. Decision engine wiring proven by 19 unit tests (test_clinical_plus_options_rerank.py). DEMOTED 2026-03-13: REGULATORY classification audit across 408 snapshots found zero REGULATORY+less_binary rows — not a bug, genuine scarcity. PDUFA dates are hard-dated binary events (97.7% land in binary_now). Candidate is structurally identical to baseline until this segment is populated. Infrastructure stays: options_coverage gate, ab_readiness_monitor, A/B harness (eval_b91_options_quality_weekly_ab.py). Revisit after forward regulatory event coverage expansion creates REGULATORY+less_binary population.

rulesets.description: build_window clinical_z tilt w=0.5 (NEEDS_MORE +0.01pp)
put/call ratio penalty tiebreak in build_window CLINICAL w=0.25
catalyst_type_tilt ON (Spec 030): T1-T5 quality ladder scales catalyst sort contributions + L3 sizing
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.11.0 (9f1f4587). enable_catalyst_type_tilt=true with T1=1.00/T2=0.90/T3=0.60/T4=0.40/T5=0.50. RERANK (87 dates, 2025-06..2026-03): top-60 overlap 99.2% (PASS >= 90%), mean rank shift 0.39 (PASS < 5). Effect localized to less_binary: T1/T2 move up (-0.75 signed), T3+ move down (+0.05). SIGNAL EVIDENCE (27 dates, catalyst_tilt_eval manifest): all deltas positive but effectively zero — +0.00pp hedged at 84d vs +0.20pp bar. VERDICT: NEEDS_MORE. Structurally valid (correct event-quality ordering) but economically immaterial — effect confined to mid-book less_binary names outside top-K portfolio. Do not widen scope or combine with catalyst tilt (a08749e4); revisit only if catalyst tilt clears weekly gate first.

rulesets.description: binary_now quality_primary w=0.35 (Spec 031): BQS tiebreak in binary_now + build_window
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.11.0 (9f1f4587). binary_now_sort_mode=quality_primary, binary_now_quality_weight=0.35. WEIGHT SWEEP (131 dates, 4 weights): w=0.35 selected — top-20 overlap 98.4% (min 85%), mean shift 3.46, BN+BW drift 5.60, separation +1.44. Structurally correct: FDA_PDUFA/DATA_READOUT promoted, CT_PRIMARY_COMPLETION demoted within top-K. SIGNAL EVIDENCE (27/34 dates): all hedged deltas zero, IC slightly negative (-0.0031 at 84d). Boundary test at w=0.50 also zero (+0.01pp hedged, IC -0.0041). VERDICT: NEEDS_MORE. Event quality does not discriminate forward returns within binary_now/build_window — optionality anchor already captures what matters. Do not pursue further mid-book or top-book quality tiebreaks with current signal set.

rulesets.description: binary_now quality_primary w=0.50 (Spec 031 boundary): upper-bound sensitivity test
rulesets.notes: Boundary test for 846ae27b. Stronger separation (+1.94) but IC worse (-0.0041 at 84d). Hedged delta +0.01pp — noise, not signal. Confirms that BQS tiebreak ceiling is economically immaterial regardless of weight.

rulesets.description: Spec 039: hybrid options anchor (options_quality_composite with optionality_pct fallback)
rulesets.notes: Shadow-only candidate for options-anchored sort. Not evaluated against Checklist v2.

rulesets.description: cal_alpha OFF; confirmed no-op removal. Zero deltas across all horizons.
rulesets.notes: Derived from v1.11.0 (9f1f4587). enable_calendar_alpha_sort=false, weight=0.0. Signal evidence: +0.00pp at all horizons, byte-identical rankings. Cal_alpha was confirmed noise in March 27 IC audit. This is a dead-parameter removal, not a signal change. Superseded by v1.13.0 A4 selector+ranker (Spec 050).

rulesets.description: Spec 050: A4 selector (coinvest+inst 65/35) + ranker overlay, sort_anchor=selector_score. True PIT: +2.34pp/mo net, t=2.60, 67 periods.
rulesets.notes: Promoted from PIT backtest. Selector: institutional block 65% (coinvest 65%, inst_delta 35%). Ranker: bounded ±15% adjustment. Construction: EW Top-30 unchanged.

rulesets.description: Spec 062: Stage 1 Event EV tiebreaker activation. Identical to v1.13.0 except event_ev_stage=tiebreaker.
rulesets.notes: Only change vs v1.13.0: event_ev_stage='tiebreaker'. Zero effect when sort keys are distinct. Requires 30+ daily EV artifacts + governance review before promotion to active.
